name: Next WP
summary: Headless WordPress starter for Next.js 16 with dynamic post, page and taxonomy routes, search and cache revalidation.
description: A headless WordPress starter built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS v4, paired with shadcn/ui components. It reads posts, pages, authors, categories and tags through typed WordPress REST API functions, with server-side pagination, debounced search, a dynamic sitemap, OG image generation and dark mode. A companion WordPress plugin revalidates Next.js cache tags when content changes.
contains: headless WordPress starter on Next.js 16 and React 19
dynamic routes for posts, pages, authors, categories and tags
type-safe WordPress REST API functions in lib/wordpress.ts
next-revalidate WordPress plugin for instant cache revalidation
dynamic sitemap and OG image generation
one-click Railway deploy (MySQL + WordPress + Next.js) or Vercel
Vitest unit tests for utils, metadata, the API layer and the revalidate route
